rows:
يتم صعود عامل 
 الصيانة بالحبل والبكرة وتركيب البكرة على جيم البرج

تثبيت السقالة 
 الخشبية موازية لشدادات الخط حسب الرسم المرفق

يتم رفع الأراضي 
 المحلية إلى اعلي البرج وتركيبها على الوجه المراد تغيير 
 البرايدل له على موصل الخط وجيم البرج من الجهتين بعد
 نظافة 
 الموصل وجسم البرج بالصنفرة

يتم ربط البرايدل 
 المراد تغييره على الحبل البكرة قبل فك البرايدل حسب الرسم 
 المرفق

يتم فك البرايدل 
 من كفتي وصلة النهاية من على الموصل من الجهتين حسب الرسم 
 المرفق

يتم إنزال البرايدل بواسطة الحبل والبكرة إلى الأرض حسب الرسم 
 المرفق

يتم أخذ طول البرايدل القديم على الموصل الجديد لتحديد طول 
 البرايدل

يتم 
 ضغط كفتي البريدل على نهايتي الموصل الجديد بواسطة المكبس 
 الهيدروليكي

يتم تنظيف كفتي نهاية الموصل العلوي بواسطة الصنفرة ووضع طبقة 
 رقيقة من الشحم الكهربي

يتم 
 رفع البريديل الجديد بواسطة الحبل والبكرة إلى اعلي البرج 
 لتركيبة حسب الرسم المرفق

يتم 
 تركيب البريديل الجديد على موصل الخط من الجهتين

بعد الانتهاء
 من العمل يتم رفع الأرضي المحلية من على البرج ومن منطقة تأمين 
 العمل وإنزالها إلى الأرض وكذلك إنزال المعدات الساخنة

يتم 
 إخلاء الموقع من الأفراد والمعدات وإنهاء أمر الشغل

يتم 
 إبلاغ التحكم بالإنتهاء من الأعمال المطلوبة لإعادة التوصيل

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for changing a bridle on tension towers, 220 kV and 66 kV. The first draft was prepared by the Cairo Region.
Make sure a signal has been received from Control that the circuit to be worked on is disconnected and earthed from both sides.
Open a work order for the disconnected circuit, specifying the work required.
Test the circuit to be worked on with a voltage indicator.
Earth the work area from both sides.
Use occupational safety and health equipment for the workers (safety belt, safety shoes, gloves).

items: Make sure a signal has been received from Control that the circuit to be worked on is disconnected and earthed from both sides.
Open a work order for the disconnected circuit, specifying the work required.
Test the circuit to be worked on with a voltage indicator.
Earth the work area from both sides.
Use occupational safety and health equipment for the workers (safety belt, safety shoes, gloves).
Long rope with pulley (sheave)
Voltage indicator
Two (2) local earths
Hydraulic press for compressing the two bridle lugs
Aluminium/steel conductor, as per the conductor type and cross-sectional area, 15 m long
Tool bag containing a set of spanners for removing and fitting the bridle and a wire brush for cleaning
Rope with hook, wire cutter, bridle lug
Sandpaper + electrical grease + wooden scaffold

sections_en.text: Maintenance Steps to be Carried Out

rows: The maintenance worker climbs up with the rope and pulley and fits the pulley on the tower crossarm.
Fix the wooden scaffold parallel to the line stays as per the attached drawing.

Raise the local earths to the top of the tower and fit them on the face whose bridle is to be changed, on the line conductor and the tower crossarm from both sides, after cleaning the conductor and the tower body with sandpaper.
Tie the bridle to be changed to the pulley rope before removing the bridle, as per the attached drawing.
Remove the bridle from the two end-connection lugs on the conductor from both sides, as per the attached drawing.
Lower the bridle with the rope and pulley to the ground, as per the attached drawing.
Take the length of the old bridle on the new conductor to determine the length of the bridle.
Compress the two bridle lugs onto the ends of the new conductor using the hydraulic press.
Clean the two lugs of the upper conductor end connection with sandpaper and apply a thin layer of electrical grease.
Raise the new bridle with the rope and pulley to the top of the tower for fitting, as per the attached drawing.
Fit the new bridle on the line conductor from both sides.
After finishing the work, remove the local earths from the tower and from the work safety area and lower them to the ground, and also lower the hot equipment.
Clear the site of personnel and equipment and close the work order.
Notify Control that the required work is finished so that the circuit can be reconnected.

Introduction
This document sets out the steps for changing a bridle on tension towers, 220 kV and 66 kV. The first draft was prepared by the Cairo Region.
Safety Precautions
Make sure a signal has been received from Control that the circuit to be worked on is disconnected and earthed from both sides.
Open a work order for the disconnected circuit, specifying the work required.
Test the circuit to be worked on with a voltage indicator.
Earth the work area from both sides.
Use occupational safety and health equipment for the workers (safety belt, safety shoes, gloves).
Make sure a signal has been received from Control that the circuit to be worked on is disconnected and earthed from both sides.
Open a work order for the disconnected circuit, specifying the work required.
Test the circuit to be worked on with a voltage indicator.
Earth the work area from both sides.
Use occupational safety and health equipment for the workers (safety belt, safety shoes, gloves).
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Long rope with pulley (sheave)
Voltage indicator
Two (2) local earths
Hydraulic press for compressing the two bridle lugs
Aluminium/steel conductor, as per the conductor type and cross-sectional area, 15 m long
Tool bag containing a set of spanners for removing and fitting the bridle and a wire brush for cleaning
Rope with hook, wire cutter, bridle lug
Sandpaper + electrical grease + wooden scaffold
Maintenance Steps to be Carried Out
The maintenance worker climbs up with the rope and pulley and fits the pulley on the tower crossarm. | 1.
Fix the wooden scaffold parallel to the line stays as per the attached drawing. | 2.
Raise the local earths to the top of the tower and fit them on the face whose bridle is to be changed, on the line conductor and the tower crossarm from both sides, after cleaning the conductor and the tower body with sandpaper. | 3.
Tie the bridle to be changed to the pulley rope before removing the bridle, as per the attached drawing. | 4.
Remove the bridle from the two end-connection lugs on the conductor from both sides, as per the attached drawing. | 5.
Lower the bridle with the rope and pulley to the ground, as per the attached drawing. | 6.
Take the length of the old bridle on the new conductor to determine the length of the bridle. | 7.
Compress the two bridle lugs onto the ends of the new conductor using the hydraulic press. | 8.
Clean the two lugs of the upper conductor end connection with sandpaper and apply a thin layer of electrical grease. | 9.
Raise the new bridle with the rope and pulley to the top of the tower for fitting, as per the attached drawing. | 10.
Fit the new bridle on the line conductor from both sides. | 11.
After finishing the work, remove the local earths from the tower and from the work safety area and lower them to the ground, and also lower the hot equipment. | 12.
Clear the site of personnel and equipment and close the work order. | 13.
Notify Control that the required work is finished so that the circuit can be reconnected. | 14.
